decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor module is a newly launched item in a modular sensor ecosystem with its own product page, and firms of this type keep such modules on sale for many years.
The voltage measurement module was just launched to replace its predecessor, so it is the current version and will remain on the market.
The MQTT proxy software costs little to maintain and supports IoT integration of the hardware line, so there is little reason to drop it.
The CAN bus interface module serves industrial and automotive users and fills out the modular portfolio, so it is likely to stay.
CO2 sensing is in growing demand for building automation, and the module is newly launched with a dedicated page.
This touch panel accessory complements the firm's displays and is cheap to keep in the catalog, though accessories carry slightly higher discontinuation risk.
